objective_breakdown: Five criteria from task text: capacity >=2 Ah (stage2, 1C discharge DFN), 5C retention >=95% (stage2, 5C cap / same-params 1C cap, mechanical ratio), power density >=4000 W/kg (stage2, calc-energy V_OC^2/(4*DCR)/mass), 4C charge no plating (stage3, anode_potential_v min >= 0 V), T_max <=60 C = 333.15 K (stage3, 5C discharge and 4C charge 45C, worst case governs). Trade-offs: energy density unconstrained -> favor power (thin electrodes/CCs); baseline 5.0 Ah vs 2 Ah target gives ~2.5x thinning headroom (capacity ~ thickness x area); T_max at 4C/45C is expected binding constraint (15 K margin); 5C retention and plating resistance share transport levers (aligned); N/P up helps plating but adds mass (PD down).
candidate_strategy: R1 baseline characterization (no overrides): 1C SPMe->DFN, 5C DFN thermal, 4C charge 45C DFN thermal+plating, calc-energy -> gap to each criterion + opening ceiling assessment. R2+ free exploration (exploration_force OFF): power deficit -> thinner electrodes/CCs; 5C retention deficit -> smaller particle radii/higher porosity/thinner electrodes/higher sigma; plating -> N/P up/smaller negative particles/negative porosity/sigma-t+; T_max -> cooling h escalation (10 -> 20-30 forced-air class) + DCR reduction. Fallback routing per symptom-to-scale mapping.
budget_allocation: Baseline 1 round; architecture/formulation exploration 3-6 rounds; safety fine-tuning 1-2 rounds; closing 1 round. Expected total 6-10 rounds, no hard cap.
risk_and_fallback: R1 T_max binding risk -> cooling-h escalation within thermal freedom, evidence packages per round; R2 plating chain: negative particle radius -> negative porosity -> N/P -> sigma/t+; three-strike rule triggers layer-by-layer questioning before any system switch; R3 5C retention >=95% demanding -> particle radius/porosity/thinning/formulation chain, honest negative-result close with relaxation statement if exhausted; R4 PD >=4000 -> thin electrodes + thin CCs + small particles, ceiling quantified after baseline. No post-hoc threshold relaxation.

detail: start_stage=3: this case starts at Stage 3 (cell design); materials use system baseline (source=baseline). base=Chen2020 (NMC811/graphite + SEI, aging-capable). Matching basis: task text names no electrode system -> anchor-table default Chen2020 (deterministic); anchor verified by parameter dump of the chosen set: positive OCP nmc_LGM50_ocp_Chen2020, negative OCP graphite_LGM50_ocp_Chen2020 (pure graphite, no SiOx keys), negative density 1657 kg/m3, SEI kinetic rate constant 1e-12 m/s present, nominal capacity 5.0 Ah. No molecular candidates proposed (no funnel screening).

detail: Opening ceiling assessment (ceiling_escalation ON, executed during baseline characterization): baseline gaps = 5C retention 0.087 (target 0.95), 4C T_max 354.3 K (target 333.15 K), 4C plated=true; capacity 4.95 Ah and power density 22383 W/kg already pass. Root cause: positive solid-diffusion time tau=r^2/D = (5.22um)^2/4e-15 = 6812 s >> 720 s (5C) -> diffusion-limited collapse; negative tau=1040 s. Assessed levers (best-possible cell-level combination): particle radius pos 5.22->1.5 um (tau 562 s), neg 5.86->3.0 um (tau 273 s), CT area x3.5/x2.0; porosity 0.335/0.25 -> 0.40/0.35 with physically consistent AMVF 0.58/0.63; t+ 0.2594->0.40 (charge concentration polarization); cooling h 10->25 W/m2K (forced-air class, thermal-management freedom) cuts DeltaT 2.5x; electrode thinning headroom 2.5x (5.0 vs 2 Ah floor) and thin CCs for mass/DCR. Ceiling conclusion: all five criteria reachable at cell scale; no Stage 2 material-design escalation needed; proceed with Stage 3 architecture/formulation rounds.

reason: Two events: (1) round-3 simulation overturned the N/P direction - retention regressed 0.951 -> 0.736 because with N/P 1.3 the cathode reaches its deep low-x region at 1C (inflated denominator) while 5C capacity stayed flat ~2.65 Ah; (2) probe verified the protocol C-rate follows 'Nominal cell capacity [A.h]' (cell/probe_nominal_1c_dfn.json: 1C discharge 3638.7 s at 3.6 A vs 2609.6 s at 5 A under nominal 5.0) - the designed ~3 Ah cell was being tested at 20/25 A (effective 6.7-8.6C) instead of its own 4C/5C
candidate_strategy: Round 4: (a) rebalance N/P to ~1.15-1.2 (negative 60 um) so the anode limits the 1C denominator again; (b) raise cathode 5C accessibility (pos r_p 1.2 um, tau 360 s); (c) anode transport/uniformity package for plating (neg r_p 2.0 um tau 121 s, neg porosity 0.42 + AMVF 0.56, separator 9 um / porosity 0.55, t+ 0.5); (d) h 45 ducted forced-air cooling; (e) rate the cell at its designed capacity via 'Nominal cell capacity [A.h]' override so all C-rate protocols use the cell's own C-rates (rating is a design output, not an excluded parameter)
budget_allocation: Round 4: 3 candidates x 3 DFN protocols + calc-energy (V6 isolates the retention rebalance, V7 isolates the plating package on the thick anode, V8 integrates both + h45). Round 5 reserve for fine-tuning if V8 is close.

llm_reason: Round-3 learnings: (a) N/P 1.3 regressed retention - the thick anode lets the cathode reach its deep low-x region at 1C (3.62 Ah denominator) which 5C cannot follow (2.65 Ah); (b) plating onset is anode interface saturation mid-charge (non-uniform lithiation at 20 A), so the fix is interface uniformity and transport, not more N/P; (c) probe cell/probe_nominal_1c_dfn.json verified the protocol C-rate follows 'Nominal cell capacity [A.h]' (3638.7 s at 3.6 A vs 2609.6 s at 5 A) - rounds 1-3 tested the 2.8-3.6 Ah designs at effective 6.7-8.6C instead of the required 4C/5C; the override makes the C-rate tests physically consistent (cell rating is a design output, not an excluded parameter). V6 isolates retention rebalance, V7 isolates the plating package, V8 integrates both + h45. Parameter sources: separator 9 um / porosity 0.55 = power-cell ceramic-coated separators (domain experience); neg porosity 0.42 + AMVF 0.56 + 2% binder (estimate, marked); t+ 0.5 = concentrated-electrolyte class (estimate, marked); h 45 = ducted forced-air pack cooling (domain experience); nominal 3.0/3.6 = mechanical rating consistent with designed capacities.

reason: real_compute=false (task default per entry 0 meta): Stage 5 true DFT/MD endorsement skipped; no DFT/MD values fabricated; all closing values come from DFN simulation outputs with mechanical log-evaluate evidence (file:key sources).

recommendation: Final design V8 (bridge/params_v8.json) meets all five entry-0 criteria mechanically (round-4 log-evaluate records all pass): NMC811/graphite (Chen2020 baseline) rated 3.0 Ah with 1C capacity 2.6683 Ah (>=2.0); 5C retention 0.9842 (>=0.95) at the cell true 5C = 15 A; power density 73121.8 W/kg (>=4000); T_max 308.45 K at 5C and 323.57 K at 4C charge / 45 C ambient (<=333.15 K); plated=false (anode potential min +0.0119 V). Key design moves: small particles (pos 1.2 um tau=360 s, neg 2.0 um), thin electrodes (50/60 um), anode porosity 0.42 + 9 um/0.55 separator, sigma 1.4 S/m + t+ 0.5, h 45 W/m2K forced-air cooling, and rating the cell at its designed 3.0 Ah so the C-rate protocols use the cell own currents (probe-verified: cell/probe_nominal_1c_dfn.json). The design is anode-capacity-limited by intent (1C capacity scales with negative AMVF: 2.9907 x 0.56/0.63 = 2.658 vs 2.6683 measured), which leaves the anode below saturation at 4C charge end and yields the plating margin. Margins: capacity +33%, retention +3.4 points, power ~18x, thermal 9.6 K at 4C; plating margin +11.9 mV is positive but thin - DFMEA item 1 recommends production tolerance control on negative particle size/porosity and 4C charge-rate discipline. Alternative: V7 (rated 3.6 Ah, 3.5321 Ah, retention 0.9775, 10 mV plating margin) if higher capacity is preferred. Limitations (honest): cycle life not simulated (aging model exists in the parameter set, no aging protocol run); shell/enclosure and electrolyte density not in the parameter set (electrolyte excluded from contract mass); real_compute=false so Stage-5 true DFT/MD endorsement skipped; abuse tests (nail/overcharge/crush) N/A in the DVPR. Deliverables: design_spec.md, bom.xlsx, datasheet.docx, calc.xlsx, dvpr.md, dfmea.md, delivery_index.md with PDF releases in deliverables/; report.html rendered from log.jsonl.
